hint.text:
For example:
I did this by myself.
→ myself = reflexive pronoun
hint.label: Example

b: ++Reflexive pronouns are words that refer back to the person or thing doing the action.
Reflexive pronouns are words that can replace the verb of a sentence.
Reflexive pronouns are words that don’t name or refer to any specific thing or person.

instruction.text: Match the reflexive pronouns to the personal pronouns they refer to.
Complete the sentences with the correct reflexive pronouns.

atoms.a: Did you bake the biscuits by ...
atoms.sound: Did you bake the biscuits by yourself?
I don’t mind laughing at myself.

atoms.a: In the film, there was a car that could drive ...
atoms.sound: In the film, there was a car that could drive itself.

atoms.a: My mum rebuilt the tree house ...
atoms.sound: My mum rebuilt the tree house herself.

instruction.text: Match the reflexive pronouns with the personal pronouns they refer to.
Fill in the gap with the correct reflexive pronoun.

atoms.b: We should go there and see for ((++ourselves themselves)).
I hope that you are enjoying ((++yourselves myself)).
My aunt Catherine and her wife treated ((++themselves herself)) to chocolate biscuits.
